text.title: Spring Boot Patterns Procedure
text.summary: 6-step procedure to scaffold or harden a Spring Boot 3 layered service end-to-end.

step.name: convert-to-constructor-injection
step.action: Replace `@Autowired` fields with `private final` + constructor. Use Lombok `@RequiredArgsConstructor` for brevity. Run an ArchUnit rule banning field injection.
step.decision-gate: If field injection remains, BLOCK per `constructor-injection` rule.

step.name: define-records-and-mapstruct
step.action: For each entity define a request record and a response record. Add `@Mapper(componentModel = "spring") interface FooMapper`. Configure the MapStruct annotation processor in `pom.xml`.
step.decision-gate: If hand-written mapper or `BeanUtils.copyProperties` is found, BLOCK per `mapstruct-for-mapping` rule.

step.name: scaffold-controllers-and-services
step.action: For each endpoint add `@RestController` (bind the body with `@Valid`, delegate to the service, return a record). Give every request record Jakarta Bean Validation constraints, and mark nested collections `@Valid` so their elements are checked too. `@Service` carries business logic; class-level `@Transactional(readOnly = true)` with write methods overriding.
step.decision-gate: If `@Transactional` lands on controller / repository, fail per `transactional-on-service` rule.
If a request body is bound without `@Valid`, or the record carries no constraints, BLOCK per `validation-on-controller` rule.

step.name: add-problemdetail-advice
step.action: Add a single `@RestControllerAdvice` mapping each domain exception (`ResourceNotFoundException`, `ConflictException`, `ValidationException`) to RFC 7807 `ProblemDetail` with the appropriate status.
step.output: One advice covering the whole module
step.decision-gate: If a controller catches business exceptions itself, BLOCK per `advice-not-per-controller` rule.

step.name: harden-repository-with-pagination
step.action: Repository list methods take `Pageable` and return `Page<DTO>` (project entity → DTO inside the service `@Transactional`). Use `@EntityGraph`/`JOIN FETCH` for required associations.

step.name: expose-and-secure-actuator
step.input: Probe + scrape requirements from the platform team
step.action: Set `management.endpoints.web.exposure.include=health,info,prometheus` — an explicit allow-list, never `*`. Enable the liveness and readiness health groups for the orchestrator's probes and put the remaining endpoints behind Spring Security. Run `scripts/spring-boot-layering-audit.sh` against the project before merge.
step.output: Probes answering, Prometheus scraping, no `env` / `heapdump` exposure
step.decision-gate: If exposure is a wildcard or the actuator is unauthenticated beyond health, BLOCK per `actuator-health-required` rule.
